member.name: T:CompasPb.Data.CompasPbRegistrationsAttribute
member.summary: Points CompasPb at a type that registers an assembly's conversions.

remarks.para: Apply this at assembly level so a package's domain types work by being referenced, without the host application calling into the package at startup:

The named type must expose a public static method with no parameters, called Register unless says otherwise. CompasPb invokes it at most once per type. The method body should be ordinary and calls, which keeps the generic instantiations statically visible for ahead-of-time compilation; only the call into the method is discovered.
Under IL2CPP or any trimming linker, preserve the registrar so the method survives stripping.

member.name: P:CompasPb.Data.Registry.DiscoveryFailures
member.summary: The failures swallowed while sweeping loaded assemblies for registrations.
member.remarks: A sweep runs over assemblies the caller does not own, so it never lets one of them throw: a plugin with a broken registrar would otherwise stop every assembly after it from registering, and the first sweep runs from this type's initializer, where an escaping exception would poison the registry for the rest of the process. The failures land here instead. Each registrar is claimed before it runs, so a failing one is never retried and this is the only record of it. still throws: there the caller named the assembly, so the failure is theirs to handle.

member.summary: Invokes the registrars declared by on every loaded assembly. Each registrar runs at most once, so this is safe to call again after more assemblies have loaded.
member.remarks: A registrar that throws does not stop the ones after it, in its own assembly or in any other; its failure is recorded in instead.

member.name: M:CompasPb.Data.Registry.WatchAssemblyLoads
member.summary: Keeps discovery current as the process loads more assemblies.
member.remarks: A sweep only ever sees what reports, and the runtime loads a referenced assembly lazily — on first use of one of its types, not because a project referenced it. A domain package whose types the host has not touched yet is therefore invisible to the sweep, and without this its registrar would never run unless the host called discovery again by hand at exactly the right moment.

member.name: M:CompasPb.Data.Registry.DiscoverRegistrations(System.Reflection.Assembly)
member.summary: Invokes the registrars declared by on one assembly. Each registrar runs at most once.
member.remarks: Unlike the sweep over every loaded assembly, this throws when a registrar fails: the caller picked the assembly, so the failure is about code they meant to load.

member.name: M:CompasPb.Data.Registry.GetJsonTypeRegistry
member.summary: The protobuf backing the JSON format, covering every message this registry knows about.
member.remarks: protobuf-json cannot read or write an Any field without a descriptor for the message inside it. The binary path can resolve a type lazily when a lookup misses, but and need the whole set up front, so this scans loaded assemblies before handing the registry over. Python's MessageToJson gets the same coverage from the default descriptor pool.

member.name: M:CompasPb.Data.Serializer.PackAsJson(CompasPb.Data.AnyData)
member.summary: Encodes a packed as a protobuf-JSON string.
member.remarks: Mirrors upstream pb_dump_json, which calls MessageToJson with its defaults. Those defaults omit fields at their default value, so this leaves FormatDefaultValues off: the JSON a C# runtime writes stays comparable with the JSON Python writes for the same object. Fields set through a oneof — which is how every arm is encoded — are written even when they hold a default value, so a zero or an empty string still survives the round trip.

member.name: M:CompasPb.ICompasPbSerializer.PackAsAnyData(System.Object)
member.summary: Converts an object to without wrapping it in a versioned envelope.

remarks.para: is the entry point for a whole payload. This is the level below it, for a domain package whose own message has AnyData fields — which compas_pb's built-in schema already does, in MeshData.edge_keys, GraphData.node_keys, and AttributeColumn.values. Filling those in by hand would mean reimplementing the recursive dispatch in every domain package.
This mirrors upstream compas_pb.core, whose own conversions.py uses the same value-level conversion to populate exactly these fields.
